input_parameters.name: pr_title
input_parameters.description: The title of the pull request.

input_parameters.name: changes_summary
input_parameters.description: A short summary of the key changes in the pull request.

input_parameters.name: test_results
input_parameters.description: The tests or checks that were run and their outcomes.

input_parameters.name: open_questions
input_parameters.description: Any open questions, risks, or review notes to highlight (optional).

tasks.title: Generate Final Review Summary
tasks.prompt_text: Create a concise pull request finalization summary for reviewer approval. Use the PR title '{{pr_title}}', changes summary '{{changes_summary}}', and test results '{{test_results}}'. If '{{open_questions}}' contains notes, call them out as risks or follow-ups. Provide a short summary, a bullet list of verification points, and an approval recommendation.
